question:
In the given figure, PAB is a secant and PT is a tangent to the circle from P. If PT = 8 cm, PA = 6 cm and AB = x cm, then the value of x is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35b998c22c340fa09b8c736369b039870eba87ab2afb864ba6ea8036bedcb9ae.png]
solution:
Given:

PT = 8 cm

PA = 6 cm

Formula used

PT² = PA × PB

Here, PT is tangent

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35b998c22c340fa09b8c736369b039870eba87ab2afb864ba6ea8036bedcb9ae.png] 

Let AB be "x"

PT² = PA × PB

8² = 6(6 + x)

32/3 = 6 + x

x = 14/3

**The value of AB is 14/3 cm.**
